content: Facade pattern: injecting a YouTube iframe with autoplay=1 via document.createElement inside a click event handler is a valid user gesture; Chrome/browser autoplay-with-sound policies permit it because the DOM insertion happens synchronously within the click callback. Cross-origin iframe still needs allow="autoplay" on the iframe tag for the child frame to be granted the autoplay permission from the parent's user-activation state. mute=1 is only needed for page-load-triggered (non-gesture) autoplay, not click-triggered.
